comments.body:
@ZJY0516 Did you test with tensor parallelism enabled? The bug didn't appear for 1xH100 for me as is specific for the all_reduce fusion. Please retry with multiple GPUs, for example --tensor-parallel-size 2. Also check Flashinfer all-reduce is enabled.

```bash
VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND=trtllm \
vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --compilation-config '{"pass_config":{"fuse_allreduce_rms":true}}'
```
